sweep.mode: capstone CS_MODE_32, disasm_lite, 65536-byte chunks, byte-wise resync on decode gaps, never detail=True, never materialising the instruction list

iid_census.rule: A is a 4-byte-aligned address inside file-backed bytes of .rdata or .data; reading 16 bytes at A: dword[1]==0, (dword[2]&0xFFFF)==0x00C0, dword[3]==0x46000000 (little-endian)

q1.push_detection: regex 68+LE32(0x7f7c80) over .text; keep a hit only when its address is an instruction start of the linear sweep, capstone reports mnemonic=push, op_str=0x7f7c80, and insn size==5 (so bytes[1:5] are the imm32 operand)
q1.primary_criterion: A_containment (= B_innermost on this population): reverse-CFG enclosure, walking predecessors of the site over fall-through / jcc-target / jmp-target / call-target edges until an entry (PE entry point or direct E8 call target) is hit. Unique for 60/60 sites.

entries.note: only 709034 of 1392527 decoded instructions are reachable from PE entry + direct call targets; the rest are reachable only through indirect calls / data pointers
